programme.desc: Puerto Rico: The local interest in hockey is growing, with young players working to make hockey part of their culture. But the biggest obstacle for the Puerto Rico Ice Hockey Federation is bringing an ice surface back on to the island. Former NHL player Al Montoya revisits memories of playing in an NHL game in Puerto Rico in 2006, and how far the game has come.

programme.title: Every Shift - Ep 3 Work, Compete, Effort
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with the Chicago Blackhawks as the team faces a turning point in the season. With Connor Bedard and Frank Nazar sidelined due to injuries, new leaders step up and the team embraces a "next man up" mentality. Away from the rink, the cameras tag along for an off day with three of the organization's youngest-Nick Lardis, Ryan Greene, and Oliver Moore-showing their chemistry and perspective beyond the grind.

programme.title: Every Shift - Ep 4 The Next Step
programme.desc: As the season winds down following trade deadline, Every Shift takes a step back to evaluate where the team stands and where it's headed next. Spend the day with Alex Vlasic and Wyatt Kaiser as they reflect on their development and what it means to take on larger roles down the stretch. The episode also features exclusive sit-down conversations with Danny Wirtz and Kyle Davidson, offering an honest assessment of the organization's current state, the impact of deadline decisions, and the long-term vision taking shape in Chicago.
